Trace Link producers now retain bounded, immutable local scenario checkpoints and reject noncanonical run identities and malformed artifact JSON. Interrupted or stopped runs preserve their history/reservation and release no recovery windows. Publication status is explicitly `UNKNOWN_NOT_TRACKED`; these files do not establish Kafka acknowledgement or delivery-level exactly-once behavior.

Stacked on Day 4 Draft PR #95, base `feature/ion-tracelink-scoped-scenarios` at `e3d0a41da141f2a836edbd35258ba878efc335dd`. Tested implementation is `6a6231113f9655534e14e54af204fb6c51cb4b92`; subsequent changes contain documentation, evidence and artifact-byte attributes. Plan milestone is 14 October; execution was 12 October 2026.

## Implementation and failure evidence

- Fix two reproduced defects: first-use run ID could disagree with its command, and artifact parsing accepted trailing JSON. Regression-first run: two tests, two expected failures. Strict parsing also rejects duplicate keys before creating output.
- Add versioned/checksummed checkpoint files bounded to 8 MiB, 128 retained runs, eight windows and three observations per window. Flushed atomic no-clobber publication preserves earlier evidence. Restored unfinished runs become INTERRUPTED; completed/stopped reservations retain identity. Missing publication metadata and conflicting parameters/history fail closed. No background worker, automatic resume or delivery ledger is introduced.
- Verify stop before the first minute, during degradation and during recovery; disk restart; completed command retry; concurrent exact commands/artifact writers; byte/timestamp preservation; and recovery-phase telemetry gaps. Missing/stale/insufficient evidence never manufactures healthy recovery. Native UTC 300-second history remains separate from live 60-second simulation.
- Pause/unpause real disposable PostgreSQL: unavailable-before-import transaction fails, read-only output fails without creating/replacing artifacts, and exact recovery preserves source rows/payload/checksums. Final drill: 12,136 ms unavailable; 720 ms restored availability plus bounded import/retry. These are local drill timings, not connected capacity.
- Reuse native importer rollback, committed-batch interruption/resume, checksum, duplicate, manifest-conflict and runtime privilege tests. Full supplied archive import/retry verified 362,880 immutable rows; 14 producer/SQL parity cases matched exactly. Enabled retention preserves unfinished/completed native provenance, and the unchanged frozen V016 held outbox survives producer/retention jobs. No retention defect or schema change was required.

## Verification

**Single complete clean Java reactor: 1,250 reported / 1,246 passed / four optional skips / zero failures or errors**, 17m51s. Includes ReplayIT, FinalizerRaceIT, DependencyOutageIT, geographic coverage/replay, importer/producer/primitive, scenario/truth-leakage, legacy outbox and retention tests. Archive and V016 opt-ins were explicitly enabled and passed. Focused results (30 reported / 29 passed / one archive skip) are separate and are not added to the full run.

Python discovery: **119 passed**; contracts passed. Persisted VoLTE/SMS parity: **7/12 cases** matched all fields. Four-language arithmetic: **54 cases per language**, maximum difference **0**. Scenario arithmetic: **144 measured points**; external reference engine: **708,498 checks**; adapter compatibility: **75 checks**. Packaged checkpoint rehearsal: three Transport windows/nine observations, immutable replay, explicit INTERRUPTED/STOPPED restoration, zero restart output, Kafka DISABLED.

Skips: three live ML HTTP cases without `ML_SERVICE_URL`, and SMS shadow replay without `SMS_SHADOW_REPLAY_DIR`. Initial sandbox cleanup/dependency failures, the corrected outage-test exception assertion, and the premature voice-export check are recorded separately. Full source remained fixed during verification; final evidence records exact commands, individual suites, hardware and artifact/log hashes.

## Boundaries and handoffs

Kafka remains **DISABLED / PENDING_REVIEW** for new Trace Link producers. No production topic, consumer edit, legacy-topic alias, applied migration, held-outbox release, demo reset or owner-branch rewrite occurs. Existing approved VoLTE/SMS paths remain unchanged.

Connected capacity is **BLOCKED**: no compatible approved new-domain consumer/delivery path. The shared 120-second warmup / 900-second steady-state / bounded burst / recovery profile is retained; new-domain offered/ACK/persisted/finalized rates, lag and drain are not measured. Legacy Kafka tests and local artifact timing do not satisfy that gate.

Runbooks cover ownership, namespaces, seeds, execution timing, safe restart, import resume, missing/stale/late semantics, credentials and indefinite retention/storage limitations. Technical handoffs are prepared for Sergiu (detector/truth/UNKNOWN controls), Denis (immutable ingestion/retry/ACK contracts), David (five supported types and stable status/gap behavior), and Stanislav (read-only roles, deployment/capacity/topic gates). Independent receiving-owner reproduction is **NOT VERIFIED**.

Complete release readiness remains **BLOCKED** on approved consumer/transport, connected incident/API/UI/Grafana acceptance, deployment/backup/restore, capacity and five-owner sign-off. Keep this PR Draft; do not merge or enable auto-merge.
